hunks.baseline: As long as I could block it.
hunks.sol: As long as I could stop it.

hunks.baseline: As long as I was not too late.
hunks.sol: As long as I wasn’t too late.

hunks.baseline: Along with a cry that never escaped my lips, I kicked off the ground once more.
hunks.sol: With the cry trapped inside my throat, I kicked off the ground once more.

hunks.baseline: In the slowed world, a deafening roar like the splitting of heaven filled my ears, and a blinding flash flooded my vision.
hunks.sol: In a world slowed to a crawl, a deafening roar like heaven splitting apart filled my ears, and a blinding flash swallowed my vision.

hunks.baseline: [^1]: The Lotus Sutra, one of the major scriptures of Mahayana Buddhism.
hunks.sol: [^1]: The Lotus Sutra is one of the major scriptures of Mahayana Buddhism.
